mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_course (student_id, course_id, enroll_date, score, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{enrollDate}, #{score}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE student_course SET score = #{score}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE student_course SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student_course WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0
